ety.text: From the fact that crossing something out often results in the shape of the letter X.
From Latin ex (“out of, from”); originated as a telegraphic abbreviation.

senses.d: The name of the Latin script letter X/x.
ex: Thus first C checks to see if ex and wye are equal. The resulting value of 1 or 0 (true or false) then is compared to the value of zee.

You upset cuz your friend got exed
I got pissed cuz my bro got knifed

senses.d: A former partner or spouse; an ex-girlfriend, ex-boyfriend, ex-wife, or ex-husband.
ex: My friend has an ex who now lives abroad.
Her ex is still sending her flowers, even though she has moved on.

senses.d: Ex-, former, previously but no longer.
My algebra II teacher's dad is an ex PE teacher at the same school.
the place the train originated from or called at prior to the present location.
ex: The train was the 12.40 p.m. ex Derby on January 14th, 1914
